text: 🧱 THE DAILY BLOCK · THU 15 OCT ₿ BTC $81,106 (-0.6%) · ETH $2,367 (-2.1%) · Fear & Greed 53 🇮🇳 NIFTY 22,623 (-0.4%) · SENSEX 72,782 (-0.3%) at Wednesday's close 📉 One hot number wiped out $455M. US inflation hit 3.7% last night, and core inflation rose to 2.6%, above the 2.5% forecast. Bitcoin slid from $84,049 to $80,150 on Kraken. ⚠️ 87% of the losers were betting up. $398M of the $455M force-closed in 24 hours were longs, about 109,600 traders. We flagged it on Tuesday: spot sat through the print, borrowed bets didn't. Know your liquidation price before you open a trade. 🔢 What drove it: gasoline jumped 9.1% in a month, over half of September's rise. The Fed meets on 27-28 October, and a hotter core makes another hike likelier. 🇮🇳 India ran hot too. A hotter wholesale inflation print pushed bond yields up, and the Sensex slipped 252 to 72,782. IT and FMCG still rose over 1%. 🎲 DEGEN WATCH: ZK ran 49% in a week on our Kraken data, from $0.0114 last Thursday to $0.0170, while bitcoin fell.
